test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ts_alloc_by_series (id UInt32, timestamp DateTime, value Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (id, timestamp)
CREATE TABLE ts_alloc_by_time (id UInt32, timestamp DateTime, value Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (timestamp, id)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ts_alloc_by_series SELECT number % 20000 AS id, toDateTime(intDiv(number, 20000) * 10) AS timestamp, (intDiv(number, 20000) % 1000)::Float64 AS value FROM numbers_mt(20000 * 2000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE ts_alloc_by_series FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1
INSERT INTO ts_alloc_by_time SELECT * FROM ts_alloc_by_series
OPTIMIZE TABLE ts_alloc_by_time FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1

SELECT throwIf(count() != 2, 'timeseries_to_grid_bucket_allocation: expected 1 active part per table; the layout pin is not in effect') FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table IN ('ts_alloc_by_series', 'ts_alloc_by_time') AND active
test.query: SELECT id, timeSeriesRateToGrid(0, 20000, {step}, {step})(timestamp, value) FROM ts_alloc_by_series GROUP BY id FORMAT Null
SELECT id, timeSeriesRateToGrid(0, 20000, {step}, {step})(timestamp, value) FROM ts_alloc_by_time GROUP BY id FORMAT Null
